# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/P4suta/aozora-wasm-static-html-example/security/advisories/new).
Do not disclose a vulnerability in a public issue before a fix is available. Include reproduction
steps, affected inputs or artifacts, expected impact, and any suggested mitigation. A complete report
will be acknowledged within seven days; publication timing will be coordinated in the advisory.

This repository is a build-time example and serves no application code to browsers.
Reports about the parser itself belong in the
[`P4suta/aozora` security policy](https://github.com/P4suta/aozora/security/policy).
Rights-metadata corrections that are not software vulnerabilities belong in the rights corpus
repository.
